title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Ampitheatre on 1982-07-29
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.22 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Sennheiser 421 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell UDXLII-C90/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Solid front‑of‑board recording captures a wild Rocky Mountain show with a rare Crazy Fingers, but the unconventional set pacing leaves fans divided.
ai_review.review: The FO board tape delivers an "in‑your‑face" sound that ranks among the better 1982 recordings, preserving the high‑energy atmosphere of those three nights at The Rocks. Listeners love the surprise return to "Crazy Fingers", yet the odd song sequencing (e.g., Minglewood into Friend of the Devil) creates a psychedelic pacing that some find unsettling.

ai_rating.rationale: One positive review praises sound quality and rare song, another gives a zero‑star rating citing strange pacing; limited data leads to a modest average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the audio as crisp and "in your face," comparable to other strong 1982 soundboard releases.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusual pacing with unexpected song pairings (e.g., Minglewood > Friend of the Devil) creates a quirky, psychic feel.
